title: Military Kills FARC Dissident Commander 'El Ruso' in First Strike of New Offensive
detail: Colombian Army Intelligence and Air Force units killed Hernando Forero Mosquera, alias 'El Ruso' (also 'Alemán'), commander of Front 28 of the FARC dissidents loyal to Iván Mordisco, in a military operation in rural Mapiripán, Meta. Three other members of the group died alongside him and six rifles were seized. 'El Ruso' was an explosives expert who ran a logistics corridor spanning Arauca, Casanare, Guaviare, and Meta departments, and was linked to IED and armed-drone attacks on military and police facilities. President Abelardo de la Espriella, sworn in two days earlier, announced the strike via video message as the first major result of his declared military offensive against armed groups, following his rejection of predecessor Gustavo Petro's Total Peace policy.
